title: Initial configuration of the guessing phase
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $x$ be a binary input. The initial configuration of the guessing-phase machine for $M$ on $x$ equals the invariant configuration corresponding to the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$ with the empty captured word.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
replaced: For every deterministic machine $M$ over the binary alphabet and every input $x$, the blank-tape initial configuration of the guessing-phase machine of $M$ on $x$ equals the invariant configuration for the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$ with empty captured word.
